name: LightRays
description: Soft angled rays of light that sweep slowly across the parent, drawn with CSS only.

color.description: Colour of the rays: any CSS colour or token.

angle.description: Angle of the rays in degrees.

isStill.description: Stops all movement. Moving content should be stoppable.

requirements: Pure decoration: aria-hidden, never focusable, and pointer-events none so content on top stays usable
Drawn with CSS gradients only, so it needs no JavaScript and is safe in server HTML
The sweep is slow and soft, with no hard edge crossing the screen
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), with isStill, and inside an rdm-still container
Nothing flashes more than 3 times a second (WCAG 2.3.1) and moving content can be stopped (WCAG 2.2.2)
Hidden in forced-colors (high contrast) mode so it never fights system colours
Keep text on top at 4.5:1 against the effect: use a low-contrast colour

use_when: A soft glow behind a hero heading
Adding depth to a dark surface
avoid_when: On very bright surfaces where the rays disappear
anti_patterns: A saturated colour at full strength behind text
A short duration that makes the light feel restless
